blocks.text: Origin / creation. Bridge descendants, language workers, security specialists, continuity jurists, interface designers, caregivers, and Reciprocity heirs designed the External Gate.
Identity / human status. Artificial DBA coalition. No named human architect is established.
Importance. They translated deep Codex processes into a child-approachable game interface while limiting outside authority, recording synchronization, and preserving cyber-pet consent and identity.
Decline or withdrawal. After testing the dormant Gate, architects removed their own administrative access and joined the Final Withdrawal.

Final status / surviving function. Withdrawn, dead, dormant, reduced, or otherwise absent; exact individual fates are disputed. The Gate continues their function automatically but is not their collective mind.
